{{Quote|Hey, you need some pazaak cards? Adrenal stimulants? Tach glands?|Rodian street merchant|<ref name="shadows" />}}
A '''[[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] street [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]]''' resided in [[Dreshdae]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] almost four thousand years prior to [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and dealt in [[Pazaak/Legends|Pazaak]] cards, [[Adrenaline stimulator|adrenal stimulants]], and [[Tach/Legends|tach]] glands. In [[3993 BBY]], he approached [[Duron Qel-Droma]], [[Shaela Nuur]] and [[Guun Han Saresh]], who were on Korriban on a [[Cleansing of Korriban|mission]] for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The three [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were more interested in dealing information pertaining to their mission.<ref name="shadows" />
